correctness.rationale: The Petersen graph is reconstructed from ten two-subsets and fifteen disjointness edges. For each of its 1023 nonempty vertex subsets, connected-component size is independently computed. The package contains a complete sequence for each r=1,...,10 of verified elementary free-face pairs and critical maximal faces; these removals force an acyclic discrete Morse matching with one vertex and only one other critical dimension. This proves integral wedge homotopy types. Separate complete GF(2) chain ranks and 1023-column persistent boundary reductions give the exact barcode. The actual embedded verifier has passed.

value.rationale: The canonical ten-vertex Petersen/Kneser graph supplies an identifiable nonchordal test for the modern higher-independence program. The result gives the exact integral homotopy type at every natural filtration level and captures a nontrivial interstage class invisible to individual Betti numbers; the finite computation is exhaustive and the shape is not a trivial textbook substitution.
